Officer responded to a noise complaint and found a small gathering; issued a warning.
Suspect was stopped for speeding; citation issued with no further incidents.
Responded to a domestic disturbance; parties separated and given resources.
Officers assisted in a minor traffic accident with no injuries.
Report of vandalism at local park; investigation ongoing.
Responded to shoplifting; suspect detained and released pending charges.
Noise disturbance call resolved without escalation.
Report of missing bicycle; no suspects at this time.
Officer assisted individual experiencing a mental health crisis.
Patrol check found open door at business; secured without incident.
Responded to animal complaint; dog returned to owner.
Officers resolved neighbor dispute over parking.
Officer issued warning for curfew violation to minors.
Assisted fire department with non-injury vehicle fire.
Responded to alarm; determined to be false.
Patrol found graffiti on public property; report filed.
Investigated suspicious person; no criminal activity found.
Officer provided welfare check; all parties safe.
Responded to noise complaint at apartment; occupants cooperative.
Routine patrol; nothing of note to report.
